description: React component for displaying a card to add a slice (visualization) in a dashboard, including thumbnail, metadata, and badges.

classes.name: TruncatedTextWithTooltip
classes.description: A React component that truncates text with ellipsis and shows a tooltip on hover if truncated.

classes.name: MetadataItem
classes.description: A React component that displays a label and value pair with optional tooltip, styled for metadata display.

classes.name: SliceAddedBadgePlaceholder
classes.description: A placeholder component for the 'Added' badge, positioned relative to the slice card.

classes.name: SliceAddedBadge
classes.description: A component that displays an 'Added' badge, positioned over the slice card.

classes.name: AddSliceCard
classes.description: Main React component representing a card for adding a slice, with thumbnail, metadata, and badges.

methods.name: TruncatedTextWithTooltip
methods.description: Handles text truncation with tooltip display if text overflows.

methods.name: MetadataItem
methods.description: Displays a metadata label and value with styling.

methods.name: SliceAddedBadgePlaceholder
methods.description: Renders a hidden placeholder for the 'Added' badge.

methods.name: SliceAddedBadge
methods.description: Renders the 'Added' badge positioned over the card.

methods.name: AddSliceCard
methods.description: Renders the entire add slice card with thumbnail, title, metadata, and badges.
